minIdle.description: Minimum number of idle instances in the pool.

maxIdle.description:
Maximum number of idle instances in the pool.  Default is
'org.apache.commons.pool.impl.GenericObjectPool.DEFAULT_MAX_IDLE' (e.g. 8).  This is  not specified as a
post default to allow overrides to know whether it has been manually set or not.

maxTotal.description:
Maximum total number of instances in the pool.  Default is
'org.apache.commons.pool.impl.GenericObjectPool.DEFAULT_MAX_ACTIVE' (e.g. 8).  This is  not specified as a
post default to allow overrides to know whether it has been manually set or not.

maxWaitMillis.description: Maximum amount of time borrow will wait if an instance is not available before throwing an exception.

minEvictableIdleTimeMillis.description: Minimum amount of time an instance can remain idle before being considered for eviction.

maxSharableAgeMinutes.description: Maximum age of shared connection that can still be shared by additional threads.
